commandPolicy.title: Rules
commandPolicy.intro: Manage the shell commands that may pass the command classifier without repeated review.
commandPolicy.scope: Workspace scope: these commands may skip review only for hooks using this workspace policy. The denylist and classifier still govern every command.
commandPolicy.limits: This editor manages command permissions only. It does not create file-access prohibitions or verify that an agent hook is installed.
commandPolicy.setupHelp: The server operator must configure a separate editor token of at least 32 characters and a policy file in an existing protected directory. Use the same policy path for the server and the hooks. Keep the editor token separate from the agent API key.
commandPolicy.tokenHelp: Used only for these requests; never saved in browser storage. Lock the editor when finished.
commandPolicy.prefix: An entry also permits extra arguments: npm test matches npm test -- --watch. Broad entries such as node grant broad command permissions. Built-in safety gates still apply.
commandPolicy.confirm: I approve this change for every hook using this workspace policy.
commandPolicy.previewHelp: Nothing is executed. This is the saved policy's command classification, not a final allow/block decision or proof of agent enforcement.
commandPolicy.waiting: Enter operator credentials and load the saved policy.
commandPolicy.loaded: Saved rules loaded. Agent enforcement has not been verified.
commandPolicy.saved: Rules saved. Hooks reading this same file will see the update; agent enforcement has not been verified.
commandPolicy.previewed: Saved policy classified the command. Nothing was executed.
commandPolicy.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save before classifying a command.
commandPolicy.notConfigured: Policy editing is not configured on this server. Open the setup instructions above.
commandPolicy.apiRequired: Connect with your API key in Settings first.
commandPolicy.operatorRequired: Operator authorization was refused. The agent API key alone cannot edit rules.
commandPolicy.conflict: The policy changed elsewhere. Load the latest rules before saving again.
commandPolicy.failed: The operation failed. No success is confirmed; load the policy again to inspect its state.
